$comment: SHA-256 of values from the owner's test tenant that must never be committed: account addresses and object ids. Each entry is the hash of the value lower-cased and trimmed, so this list blocks the values without publishing them. scripts/tenant-guard.mjs hashes every GUID and email address in the tracked files and fails on a match. To block a new value, add its hash here: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update(process.argv[1].trim().toLowerCase()).digest('hex'))" '<value>'.
